title: Creative Strategy
flow: See the problem, find the insight, build the idea.
practiceStatement: I find the idea inside a cultural problem, then build the world around it.
rhythm: Problem, idea, how it works, proof

projects.name: Bekaa
projects.disciplines: Creative Strategy, Brand World, Hospitality Concept
projects.oneLineOutcome: A bar built to be remembered. Concept, research and costed plan for South Kensington.

slides.title: A bar built to be remembered.

image.alt: The Bekaa room in the evening, full

slides.notes: Opening slide of the project, from the Creative Strategy PDF.

slides.title: South Kensington has places to eat. Almost none to belong.
slides.text: A neighbourhood of visitors and residents who share a postcode and rarely a room. The brief: make a bar that gives them one.

slides.title: Archival capital.
slides.text: A room that accumulates. Every night leaves something behind, and what a bar keeps is what it comes to be worth. The theory is mine; the plan makes it usable.

slides.title: Accumulate. Express. Be legible.
bullets: Accumulation. Objects, regulars and rituals gathered on purpose.
Expression. The room says what it keeps, in menu, music and dress.
Legibility. A stranger reads the story in ten seconds.

slides.title: What it kept.
slides.text: Space for the result: what the room collected, who came back, what it earned.

projects.name: VOID
projects.disciplines: Creative Strategy, Brand World, Art Direction
projects.oneLineOutcome: A fragrance house that begins with a feeling, not a scent. Concept stage.

slides.title: Fragrance, felt first.
slides.notes: Opening slide of the project, from the Creative Strategy PDF.

slides.title: The one thing I wanted was the smell of him.
slides.text: The name is the distance. Long distance, close contact unavailable, and a body reduced to a scent memory. VOID is made for that gap.

slides.title: Feelings first. Scent second.
slides.text: Ffern names perfumes after nature. VOID names them after presence. No one yet sells fragrance as a feeling, a time or a memory before it is a pleasant smell.
What does your favourite memory smell like?

slides.title: Distil a moment.
bullets: The smell of the one you love.

slides.title: The woman who yearns.
slides.text: VOID earns by luring people closer to humanity, in a time when humanity is getting more distant.
